basic_info.description: Classic San Francisco charm with good bones in Visitacion Valley. Nicely maintained and freshly painted, this well-lit home with 3 Skylights presents an honest canvas for buyers who appreciate original detail and potential. The upper living level enjoys warm hardwood floors, built-in shelving and arched openings that give the home character and flow. An eat-in kitchen retains its original stained wood cabinetry, serviceable layout ready for your personalization. The lower level offers a flexible bonus room, a convenient full bathroom and direct access to the garage and rear yard. Step outside from the covered rear deck to a secluded backyard with mature trees. Located close to Leland Avenue shops and eateries, McLaren Park, and with easy access to Muni, BART connections and US-101 / I-280, this is an appealing entry to San Francisco ownership.
